name: Damian Alcelait
original_name: ダミアン・アルスライト
source:
Deycas' older brother and the captain of the royal knights. He is friendly and caring, but he loves women equally, and his preferences often change (currently he likes mature women).

He is also aware that his younger brother has a crush on the Liphia, and because he teases him at every opportunity, he is quite hated.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]

Flower Emblem: Salvia
